description: AI has already transformed how we work, but the next decade could see it reshape the physical world. From fully autonomous "dark factories" in China to humanoid robots working in warehouses, aged care, construction and even the home, Bryce and Ren explore why robotics could become the next frontier of the AI revolution. They unpack the companies leading the charge, the investment opportunities emerging, and what investors should watch as AI moves beyond the chatbot and into everyday life. In thi…
classificationReason: Entire episode examines robotics as the next AI frontier, including humanoids, autonomous factories, companies, and investment opportunities.
qualityReason: Well-developed thematic reporting with timestamps, examples, and company-level discussion, though oriented toward investors.
